description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-21 when road-to-advisories-heard-the-same-day corrected this skill's example image pin, which brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover Dockerfile edits, compose services, a container that will not start, the Xdebug container, and a German phrasing. Near-misses: the CI pipeline itself (github-ci), cloud infrastructure (terraform / aws-infrastructure), and a base-image advisory (the /audit command). Counterexamples guard 'container' in a CSS-layout and a freight sense.

queries.q: my container won't start after the last pull
add a redis service to docker-compose and wire it into the app container
make the Dockerfile build faster with a multi-stage build
run phpunit inside the Xdebug container so I can step through it
der PHP-Container findet die Extension nicht — schau dir das Dockerfile an
the GitHub Actions workflow fails on the build step
write the terraform for an ECS service
is our node:22 base image affected by any advisory?
center the content inside the flex container
how many shipping containers fit on the truck?
